title: JSP Nepal Offers Condolences for Devanaganj and Golbazar Incident Victims, Demands Justice - english.ratopati.com
description: JSP Nepal Offers Condolences for Devanaganj and Golbazar Incident Victims, Demands Justice  english.ratopati.com
publisher.title: english.ratopati.com
full_article:
Kathmandu. Janata Samajwadi Party (JSP), Nepal has offered heartfelt condolences on the death of Om Prakash Mehta, who died in a police firing incident in Captainganj, Devanaganj Rural Municipality, Sunsari district, and Ganesh Yadav, who died in the Golbazar incident in Siraha.

The party has expressed deep sympathy to the bereaved families and wished for the speedy recovery of all those injured in the incident.

JSP Nepal has demanded that the government provide fair relief to the families of the deceased and arrange for the treatment of the injured. It has also stated that the incident should be impartially investigated and legal action should be taken against the culprits.

Emphasis has been placed on taking serious steps to prevent the success of tendencies that create conflict among Nepali followers who stand for harmony, brotherhood, truth, justice, and unity, thereby disrupting social harmony and spreading unrest and violent activities. A heartfelt appeal has been made to all the people to defeat the conspiracy to create enmity in the name of religion and to maintain peace, mutual harmony, brotherhood, and unity.

It has been stated that the government should take concrete steps to restore the deteriorating social harmony. The serious attention of the government has also been drawn to the need for necessary activeness, promptness, and effective initiative.

जेएसपी नेपाल सरकार सँ मृतकक परिवार के उचित राहत प्रदान करबाक आ घायल के इलाज के व्यवस्था करबाक मांग केने अछि । संगहि एहि घटनाक निष्पक्ष जाँच करबाक आ अपराधी पर कानूनी कार्रवाई करबाक बात सेहो कहल गेल अछि।

सौहार्द, भाईचारा, सत्य, न्याय, आ एकता के पक्ष में ठाढ़ नेपाली अनुयायी के बीच द्वंद्व पैदा करय वाला प्रवृत्ति के सफलता के रोकय लेल गंभीर कदम उठाबय पर जोर देल गेल अछि, जाहि सं सामाजिक सौहार्द बाधित भ गेल अछि आ अशांति आ हिंसक गतिविधि के प्रसार होयत अछि. धर्म के नाम पर दुश्मनी पैदा करै के षड्यंत्र के पराजित करी क॑ शांति, आपसी सौहार्द, भाईचारा, आरू एकता क॑ कायम रखै के सब जनता स॑ दिल स॑ आह्वान करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

कहल गेल अछि जे सरकार के बिगड़ैत सामाजिक सौहार्द के बहाल करय लेल ठोस कदम उठाबय के चाही. सरकार केरऽ गंभीर ध्यान भी आवश्यक सक्रियता, शीघ्रता, आरू प्रभावी पहल के जरूरत प॑ आकर्षित करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

title: Teen killed as communal clashes spread across Nepal; toll rises to 3 - The Federal
description: Teen killed as communal clashes spread across Nepal; toll rises to 3  The Federal
publisher.title: The Federal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Jul 30 (PTI) A teenager died on Thursday in clashes in Nepal's Madhesh province prompting authorities to extend curfew to more areas following communal violence in neighbouring Koshi province’s Sunsari district, bordering India, earlier this week that left one person dead and several others injured.

The teenager died in the clashes that erupted in Golbazar market in Siraha district of Madhesh province, while one person, who was injured in the Sunsari violence, died in Koshi province , officials said.

This takes the death toll to three in the week-long communal violence that has hit Nepal's two provinces, Koshi and Madhes, both bordering Bihar.

Indefinite curfew was imposed in parts of Dhanusa, Siraha and Birgunj districts of Madhesh province on Thursday while in Sunsari district, where curfew was first imposed on Monday, it remained in force indefinitely.

One person was killed and more than a dozen people, including security personnel, were injured when police opened fire to disperse clashing groups after a dispute during celebrations by two religious communities in the Kaptangunj area of Dewangunj Rural Municipality in Sunsari district on Sunday.

On Thursday, Ganesh Yadav, 15, of Tulsipur near Golbazar in Siraha district sustained serious injuries during the clashes between two groups. Yadav died while undergoing treatment at a local hospital, police said.

The indefinite curfew order in Golbazar area was extended to Lahan Municipality on Thursday to keep the situation under control, according to the district administration. The incident occurred during violent protests organised by different groups in the Golbazar area, where the agitators also set afire a shopping mall.

Jaya Prakash Mehta, who sustained serious injuries during communal clashes in Dewangunj Rural Municipality of Sunsari district died on Thursday while undergoing treatment at a Neuro Hospital in Biratnagar, according to Bechan Mehta, chairman of the rural municipality.

Mehta announced Nepalee Rupees one million each compensation to the two individuals killed during Sunday's communal violence in Dewangunj.

In a related development, the District Administration Office of Parsa in Madhesh province issued prohibitory orders in parts of Birgunj Metropolitan City as precautionary measures.

The administration issued prohibitory orders after demonstrations by some people in response to the violence that erupted following clashes between two religious groups in Sunsari.

The prohibitory orders were applicable to area between Pratima Chowk in the east, Tilabe bridge in the west, Gandak Chowk in the north and Shankaracharya Gate in the south of Birgunj, bordering Raxaul in Bihar, according to a notice issued by DAO Parsa.

Under the prohibitory orders, assembly of five or more people are prohibited, no demonstration, sit-in, public meeting or meeting are allowed. The prohibitory order will be in effect from 5 pm Thursday till 6 am Friday, the officials said.

Earlier on Thursday, various parts of Dhanusa, including Laxminia Hatbazaar, Belauni Road, Nagarain Municipality, Dudhmati bridge and Janakpur were placed under curfew from 3:30 pm for an indefinite period as a precautionary measure due to communal tensions, Assistant Chief District Officer of Dhanusha, Bhudev Jha, said.

The curfew imposed in Sunsari district, which was first imposed on Monday, continued to be extended for an indefinite period, though the situation was slowly improving.

Sunsari's Assistant Chief District Officer Poshan Lamichhane on Thursday said the security situation in Sunsari district is gradually improving but the district administration extended the curfew to 10 areas, including the East-West Highway, to control the situation.

Several lawmakers, including Basna Thapa of Nepali Congress and Oren Rai of Shram Sanskriti Party, drew the attention of the government towards the growing tension in the southern Nepal districts, including Sunsari, while speaking in Parliament on Thursday.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah chaired the 43rd meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) during the day, which focusing on the country’s overall law and order situation. “The meeting conducted a comprehensive review of national security and also evaluated recent unrest in Sunsari,” official sources said.

President Ramchandra Paudel, expressing deep concern over the situation, appealed to all for maintaining social, religious and communal harmony and national unity.

“Goodwill, reconciliation and brotherhood are the unique features of the identity and tradition of Nepalese people, in a country characterised by multi-cultural, multi-ethnic and multi-racial society,” President Paudel said in a statement.

He also called upon agencies concerned to take stern action against the culprits by conducting neutral and factual investigation into the incident.

Sunsari, situated in southeastern Nepal along the border with India's Bihar, is a crucial transit and commercial corridor between the two countries. The southern districts of Madhesh and Koshi provinces also share borders with Bihar. PTI

काठमांडू, मिथिला मिरर: नेपालक मधेश प्रदेशमे भेल झड़पमे गुरुवारके एक किशोरके मृत्यु भेल अछि, जाहिमे अहि सप्ताहक प्रारंभमे पड़ोसी कोशी प्रान्तके भारतक सीमामे स्थित सुनसरी जिल्लामे भेल साम्प्रदायिक हिंसाक बाद एक गोटेके मृत्यु भेल आ कतेको गोटे घायल भेलाक बाद अधिकारी बेसी क्षेत्रमे निषेधाज्ञा बढ़ाओल गेल अछि ।

मधेश प्रदेशके सिरहा जिल्लाके गोलबजार बजारमे भेल झडपमे किशोरके मृत्यु भेल अछि, तहिना सुनसरी हिंसामे घायल एक गोटेके कोशी प्रदेशमे मृत्यु भेल अधिकारीसब जनौलक अछि ।

एहि स नेपाल के दू प्रांत कोशी आ मधेश, दुनू प्रांत बिहार स सटल अछि, सप्ताह भरि चलि रहल साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा मे मृतक के संख्या तीन भ गेल अछि।

मधेश प्रदेशके धनुषा, सिराहा आ वीरगंज जिल्लाके किछु भागमे बृहस्पतिदिन अनिश्चितकालीन निषेधाज्ञा लगाओल गेल अछि त सुनसरी जिल्लामे सोमदिन सर्वप्रथम निषेधाज्ञा लगाओल गेल छल ओ अनिश्चित काल धरि लागू रहल अछि ।

सुनसरी जिल्लाके देवानगंज ग्रामीण नगरपालिकाके कपतानगुञ्ज क्षेत्रमे रविदिन दुटा धार्मिक समुदायके उत्सवके क्रममे झगड़ामे झगडैत समूहके तितर-बितर करबाक लेल प्रहरी गोलीबारी केने एक गोटेके मृत्यु भेल आ सुरक्षाकर्मीसहित एक दर्जनसँ बेसी जना घायल भेल अछि ।

बृहस्पतिदिन सिराहा जिलाक गोलबजारक समीप तुलसीपुरक १५ वर्षीय गणेश यादव दू समूहक बीच भेल झड़प मे गंभीर रूप सँ घायल भेल अछि । स्थानीय अस्पतालमे ईलाजके क्रममे यादवके मृत्यु भेल प्रहरी जनौलक अछि ।

गोलबाजार क्षेत्रमे अनिश्चितकालीन निषेधाज्ञाके आदेश बृहस्पतिदिन लहान नगरपालिकामे बढाओल गेल जिल्ला प्रशासनके अनुसार । ई घटना गोलबाजार क्षेत्र मँ अलग-अलग समूह द्वारा आयोजित हिंसक विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान घटित होलै, जहां आंदोलनकारी नँ एगो शॉपिंग मॉल मँ भी आग लगाय देलकै ।

सुनसरी जिल्लाके देवानगंज ग्रामीण नगरपालिकामे साम्प्रदायिक झड़पमे गम्भीर घायल भेल जयप्रकाश मेहताके विराटनगरके न्यूरो अस्पतालमे उपचारके क्रममे बृहस्पतिदिन मृत्यु भेल ग्रामीण नगरपालिकाके अध्यक्ष बेचन मेहता जनौलक अछि ।

मेहता देवानगंजमे रविदिन भेल साम्प्रदायिक हिंसामे मारल गेल दुनू व्यक्तिके नेपाली १० लाख रुपैयाक मुआवजा देबाक घोषणा केलन्हि ।

सम्बन्धित घटनाक्रममे मधेश प्रदेशके पर्साके जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय एहतियातके रुपमे वीरगंज महानगरपालिकाके कुछ भागमे निषेधात्मक आदेश जारी करले बा ।

सुनसरी मे दू धार्मिक समूहक बीच झड़प के बाद भेल हिंसा के जवाब मे किछु लोक के प्रदर्शन के बाद प्रशासन निषेधात्मक आदेश जारी केलक अछि।

डीएओ पर्सा द्वारा जारी सूचना मे कहल गेल अछि जे, पूर्व मे प्रतिमा चौक, पश्चिम मे तिलाबे पुल, उत्तर मे गंडक चौक आ बिहार मे रक्सौल क सीमावर्ती वीरगंज क दक्षिण मे शंकराचार्य गेट क बीच क्षेत्र मे इ निषेधात्मक आदेश लागू छल।

निषेधात्मक आदेश के तहत पांच या ओहि सं बेसी लोक के सभा पर रोक अछि, कोनो तरहक प्रदर्शन, धरना, जनसभा या बैसार के अनुमति नहिं अछि. अधिकारी सब कहलनि जे, गुरुवार के सांझ 5 बजे सं शुक्रदिन भोर 6 बजे तक निषेधात्मक आदेश लागू रहत।

अहिसँ पहिने बृहस्पतिदिन धनुषाके विभिन्न भागमे लक्ष्मीनिया हाटबजार, बेलौनी रोड, नगराईन नगरपालिका, दूधमती पुल आ जनकपुर सहित साम्प्रदायिक तनावके कारण एहतियातके रुपमे दुपहर ३:३० बजेसँ अनिश्चितकालके लेल निषेधाज्ञा लगाओल गेल धनुषाके सहायक प्रमुख जिल्ला अधिकारी भूदेव झा जानकारी देलनि ।

सुनसरी जिला मे पहिल बेर सोमदिन लगाओल गेल कर्फ्यू अनिश्चित काल तक बढ़ैत रहल, हालांकि स्थिति मे धीरे-धीरे सुधार भ रहल छल।

सुनसरी के सहायक मुख्य जिला अधिकारी पोशन लामिछाने गुरुवार के सुनसरी जिला के सुरक्षा स्थिति में धीरे-धीरे सुधार भ रहल अछि, मुदा जिला प्रशासन स्थिति पर नियंत्रण के लेल पूर्व-पश्चिम राजमार्ग सहित 10 क्षेत्र में कर्फ्यू बढ़ा देलक।

नेपाली कांग्रेसक बसना थापा आ श्रम संस्कृति पार्टीक ओरेन राय सहित कतेको विधायक बृहस्पतिदिन संसदमे बजैत सुनसरी सहित दक्षिण नेपाल जिल्लामे बढैत तनाव दिस सरकारक ध्यान आकर्षित कएलन्हि ।

प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह के अध्यक्षता में दिन में राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा परिषद (एनएससी) के 43वीं बैठक भेल, जे देश के समग्र कानून व्यवस्था के स्थिति पर केंद्रित छल. आधिकारिक सूत्र कहलनि जे, बैसार मे राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा के व्यापक समीक्षा कायल गेल आ सुनसरी मे हाल के अशांति के मूल्यांकन सेहो कायल गेल।

राष्ट्रपति रामचन्द्र पौडेल, स्थिति पर गहरी चिन्ता व्यक्त करैत सामाजिक, धार्मिक आ साम्प्रदायिक सौहार्द आ राष्ट्रीय एकता कायम रखबाक लेल सब गोटे स अपील केलनि।

राष्ट्रपति पौडेल विज्ञप्ति जारी कए कहलनि जे, बहुसांस्कृतिक, बहुजातीय आ बहुजातीय समाजक विशेषता वाला देश मे नेपाली जनताक पहिचान आ परम्पराक विशिष्ट विशेषता अछि, सद्भावना, मेलमिलाप आ भाईचारा।

ओ संबंधित एजेंसी स सेहो आह्वान केलथि जे ओ एहि घटना क तटस्थ आ तथ्यात्मक जांच क अपराधी क खिलाफ कड़ा कार्रवाई करथि।

भारत के बिहार के सीमा पर दक्षिण पूर्वी नेपाल में स्थित सुनसरी दुनु देश के बीच एकटा महत्वपूर्ण पारगमन आ वाणिज्यिक गलियारा अछि। मधेश आ कोशी प्रांतक दक्षिणी जिलाक सीमा सेहो बिहारक संग साझा अछि। पीटीआई

full_article:
Kathmandu, July 30: Former President Biddya Devi Bhandari has urged to exercise optimum restraint in the present sensitive situation.

She appealed to one and all for not flowing fake news and provocative expression of any type.

Issuing a press release today, former President Bhandari expressed serious concern over the recent communal tensions and violent incidents in some parts of the country, including Sunsari.

She noted news of people losing their lives and some others being injured in these incidents has deeply saddened her.

Bhandari offered heartfelt condolences to the deceased and wished for the speedy recovery of the injured. “Nepal is a nation with diversity in ethnicity, language, religion, and culture. Unity amid diversity, mutual respect, and social harmony are Nepal’s intrinsic identity and pride, and it is everyone’s shared responsibility to preserve them."

She further stated the priceless traditions that our ancestors built and have proudly maintained for generations will not be allowed to weaken under any circumstances,” her statement said.

Since a sustainable solution to such problems is only possible through the rule of law, mutual trust, and continuous dialogue, the former President noted, urging the Nepal government, relevant administrative bodies, and security agencies to conduct a fair, transparent, and credible investigation into the incidents and hold the guilty accountable according to the law. काठमांडू, ३० जुलाई : पूर्व राष्ट्रपति बिद्या देवी भण्डारी वर्तमान संवेदनशील स्थिति मे इष्टतम संयम करबाक आग्रह केने छथि ।

ओ एक आ सब स अपील केलनि जे कोनो तरहक फेक न्यूज आ भड़काऊ अभिव्यक्ति नहि बहय।

आइ एकटा प्रेस विज्ञप्ति जारी करैत पूर्व राष्ट्रपति भण्डारी सुनसरी सहित देशक किछु भाग मे हाल मे साम्प्रदायिक तनाव आ हिंसक घटना पर गंभीर चिंता व्यक्त केलनि।

हुनी नोट करलकै कि ई घटना मँ लोगऽ के जान आरू कुछ लोगऽ के घायल होय के खबर हुनका बहुत दुखी करी देल॑ छै ।

भंडारी मृतक के हार्दिक संवेदना व्यक्त करैत घायल के शीघ्र ठीक होयबाक कामना केलनि। "नेपाल जातीयता, भाषा, धर्म, आरू संस्कृति के विविधता वाला राष्ट्र छै । विविधता के बीच एकता, आपसी सम्मान, आरू सामाजिक सौहार्द नेपाल के आंतरिक पहचान आरू गौरव छै, आरू एकरा संरक्षित करना सब के साझा जिम्मेदारी छै।"

हुनी आगू कहलकै कि जे अमूल्य परंपरा हमरऽ पूर्वज न॑ बनयने छेलै आरू पीढ़ी-दर-पीढ़ी गर्व स॑ कायम रखन॑ छै, ओकरा कोनो भी हालत म॑ कमजोर नै होबै देलऽ जैतै ।’’ हुनकऽ बयान म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

चूँकि एहन समस्या के स्थायी समाधान कानून के राज, आपसी विश्वास, आ निरंतर संवाद के माध्यम स मात्र संभव अछि, पूर्व राष्ट्रपति नेपाल सरकार, संबंधित प्रशासनिक निकाय, आ सुरक्षा एजेंसी स आग्रह करैत नोट केलथि जे ओ घटना के निष्पक्ष, पारदर्शी, आ विश्वसनीय जांच करथि आ दोषी के कानून के अनुसार जवाबदेह बनाबथि। (आर एस एस) २.

full_article:
Nepali authorities have enforced a curfew in several places across the country's southern plain amid escalating religious tensions between Hindu and Muslim communities, police said on Thursday.

Curfews have been imposed in parts of Siraha, Sunsari and Dhanusa districts bordering the Indian state of Bihar, where religious tensions have been growing in recent days, according to Nepal Police spokesman Abi Narayan Kafle.

"Nepal Police is working with the unified security forces to prevent vandalism, arson and communal tension," Kafle said.

Kafle said that at least two people have died since Sunday, when violence erupted after Hindu pilgrims were attacked in Sunsari district of eastern Nepal while heading to a temple. He said that both victims were shot on Sunday.

One died on the same day, while the other, who had been receiving treatment, succumbed to his injuries at the hospital Thursday.

It remains unclear who fired the shots, as no security agency has taken responsibility.

President Ramchandra Paudel has expressed concern over the situation and appealed for social, religious and ethnic harmony.

Separately, Prime Minister Balendra Shah, in an address to the nation, pledged a transparent investigation into the incidents, assured medical care for the injured, and vowed action against those spreading hate and misinformation.

Nepal, a country of 29 million people, is roughly around 81% Hindu. Other religious minorities include Buddhists, Muslims and Christians.

title: Nepal PM appeals for calm as communal violence kills three in border districts - indiatoday.in
description: Nepal PM appeals for calm as communal violence kills three in border districts  indiatoday.in
publisher.title: indiatoday.in
full_article:
Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Thursday appealed for calm and harmony after three people died in communal violence in border districts, as authorities expanded curfew restrictions to more areas. In a televised address, Shah said the government would ensure a neutral and transparent investigation into the violence and hold those responsible accountable.

The unrest, which began in Sunsari district of Koshi province and later spread to parts of neighbouring Madhesh province, has led to curfews, prohibitory orders and the deployment of security forces. The government has also stepped up political and administrative measures to contain the situation and ease tensions.

Read Full Story

The violence first broke out on Sunday night in the Kaptangunj area of Devganj rural municipality in Sunsari district when members of two communities, who were separately organising programmes, clashed over the use of loudspeakers and the display of religious flags. On Thursday, the violence spread to Golbazar market in Siraha district of Madhesh province, where a teenager died in the clashes. Officials also said one person injured in the Sunsari violence died in Koshi province.

An indefinite curfew was imposed in parts of Dhanusa, Siraha and Birgunj districts of Madhesh province on Thursday, while the curfew in Sunsari district, first imposed on Monday, remained in force. Shah said the government was looking into the incidents in Sunsari's Devganj and parts of Siraha with the "utmost seriousness and sensitivity". He said health authorities had been instructed to ensure prompt treatment for the injured. He also said the home ministry had formed an investigation committee and promised that the inquiry would be impartial and transparent. Security forces have been deployed to prevent further violence and restore normalcy, he added.

According to the Prime Minister, the home minister travelled to the affected areas to oversee the security situation, while the National Security Council reviewed the unrest and took necessary decisions. Shah said an all-party meeting had been convened in Kathmandu and dialogue was continuing to ease tensions. He also urged the public not to spread rumours, misinformation or hate speech through social media or other platforms.

In a related development, the District Administration Office of Parsa in Madhesh province issued prohibitory orders in parts of Birgunj Metropolitan City as a precaution after demonstrations by some people in response to the violence in Sunsari. The restrictions covered the area between Pratima Chowk in the east, Tilabe Bridge in the west, Gandak Chowk in the north and Shankaracharya Gate in the south of Birgunj, which borders Raxaul in Bihar. Under the orders, gatherings of five or more people were banned, and no demonstration, sit-in, public meeting or meeting was allowed. Officials said the order would remain in effect from 5 pm on Thursday till 6 am on Friday. Earlier in the day, various parts of Dhanusa, including Laxminia Hatbazaar, Belauni Road, Nagarain Municipality, Dudhmati bridge and Janakpur, were placed under curfew from 3.30 pm for an indefinite period as a precautionary measure due to communal tensions, Assistant Chief District Officer of Dhanusha Bhudev Jha said. Sunsari's Assistant Chief District Officer Poshan Lamichhane said the security situation in the district was gradually improving, but the administration had extended the curfew to 10 areas, including the East-West Highway, to control the situation.

Several lawmakers, including Basna Thapa of Nepali Congress and Oren Rai of Shram Sanskriti Party, raised the issue of growing tension in southern Nepal districts, including Sunsari, in Parliament on Thursday. President Ramchandra Paudel expressed deep concern and appealed for social, religious and communal harmony and national unity. "Goodwill, reconciliation and brotherhood are the unique features of the identity and tradition of the Nepalese people, in a country characterised by a multi-cultural, multi-ethnic and multi-racial society," President Paudel said in a statement. He also called on the agencies concerned to take stern action against the culprits through a neutral and factual investigation. Overall, the government has responded with curfews, security deployment, talks and an inquiry, as Nepal seeks to contain the violence that began in Sunsari and spread to parts of Madhesh.

नेपालक प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह बृहस्पतिदिन सीमावर्ती जिल्लामे साम्प्रदायिक हिंसामे तीन गोटेके मृत्यु भेलाक बाद शान्त आ सौहार्दक आह्वान केलन्हि, कारण अधिकारी कर्फ्यू प्रतिबन्धके अधिक क्षेत्रमे विस्तार केने अछि । शाह एकटा टेलीविजन संबोधन मे कहलनि जे सरकार हिंसा के तटस्थ आ पारदर्शी जांच सुनिश्चित करत आ जिम्मेदार लोक के जवाबदेह बनाओत।

कोशी प्रांत के सुनसरी जिला स शुरू भेल आ बाद में पड़ोसी मधेश प्रांत के किछु हिस्सा में पसरल अशांति के कारण कर्फ्यू, निषेधात्मक आदेश आ सुरक्षा बल के तैनाती के कारण बनल अछि। सरकार एहि स्थिति कए रोकबा आ तनाव कम करबा लेल राजनीतिक आ प्रशासनिक उपाय सेहो तेज केलक अछि।

विज्ञापन ❮❯ २.

पूरा कहानी पढ़ें

Kathmandu [Nepal], July 30 (ANI): Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Thursday appealed for unity, restraint and social harmony as violence in the southern plains of Nepal has claimed at least three lives. "I pay my heartfelt tribute to our citizens Jayaprakash Mehta, Om Prakash Mehta and Ganesh Yadav, who passed away in this tragic incident. I also express my deepest condolences to the bereaved families on behalf of the Government of Nepal. I wish a speedy recovery to all the citizens who were injured in the incident. Clear instructions have been given to the concerned health agencies to ensure that there is no shortage or delay in the treatment of the injured," he added. The confrontation quickly escalated into stone-pelting and violence, prompting police to intervene with batons, tear gas, warning shots and eventually live fire by the Armed Police Force. One person died on the spot from gunshot injuries, while several others were critically injured. Jayaprakash Mehta, who had sustained injuries in the violence, succumbed to his injuries on Thursday, taking the death toll to three. Announcing the formation of an investigation committee, Shah assured the public that the inquiry would be fair and transparent and that those responsible would face legal action. "As soon as the incident happened, all security agencies immediately reached the spot and made continuous efforts to normalise the situation, prevent further unpleasant incidents and maintain peace and security. The Ministry of Home Affairs has formed an investigation committee to conduct a fair investigation into the incident and take strict legal action against the culprits. I would like to assure everyone that this investigation will be completely fair and transparent. The government is committed to bringing whoever is responsible for the incident to justice," Shah said. He said that the government has adopted a multi-pronged approach to restore normalcy. An all-party meeting was convened at the central level, while continuous dialogue has been held with local representatives, civil society members, religious leaders, community representatives and social activists. "The Home Minister himself has already reached the spot to directly monitor the local situation, communicate with the affected parties, and further strengthen peace and security. In addition, a meeting of the National Security Council has been convened to seriously review the overall peace and security situation in the country and necessary decisions have been taken according to the situation," he said. In his four-and-a-half-minute televised address, Shah also appealed to citizens not to spread misinformation or inflammatory content. He urged people to refrain from circulating false or unverified information, rumours, hate speech or messages that could inflame inter-community tensions, and asked them to rely only on official information issued by government agencies. He also warned that action would be taken against those attempting to disrupt peace, spread chaos or undermine Nepal's long-standing traditions of tolerance and brotherhood. "The Constitution of Nepal has granted every citizen the fundamental right to follow their own religion, culture and traditions. The government is fully committed to fulfilling this constitutional obligation. Religion is the force that unites society and spreads love. No religion or culture in the world teaches violence, hatred and division. The essence of all religions is compassion, mercy, love and peace. Blaming an entire community for an unexpected and tragic incident in one part of the country and spreading the fire of revenge for it in other parts of the country cannot be justified or justified from any perspective," the Nepalese PM said. Concluding his address with a message delivered in both Nepali and Maithili, Shah called for collective efforts to restore peace and strengthen national unity. "Our history is a witness that even in the most difficult and difficult situations, mutual unity, tolerance and conscience have become our greatest strength. We all have to play the role of responsible citizens and remove the clouds of unrest that have hung over this beautiful and peaceful Nepali sky. We, the common citizens, civil society, religious communities, all respected leaders, all political parties and responsible media, are making a heartfelt appeal to the government to exercise patience and restraint and maintain peace, harmony, brotherhood and national unity," he added. The government's response comes amid curfews, prohibitory orders and heightened security deployments in Sunsari, Siraha, Janakpur and Parsa districts. Since Sunday, protests and tensions have spread, raising concerns over broader communal friction in the region bordering India. description: Non-Resident Nepali Association Expresses Concern Over Sunsari Incidents, Urges Peaceful Resolution  english.ratopati.com
publisher.title: english.ratopati.com
full_article:
Kathmandu. The Non-Resident Nepali Association (NRNA) has expressed deep concern over the incidents in places like Devangunj, Siraha, Sunsari and urged the government and all stakeholders to maintain social harmony and seek a peaceful resolution to the problem.

In a press statement issued by the association's president Dr. Hemraj Sharma on Thursday, condolences were expressed to the citizens who lost their lives in the incident, and sympathy was extended to the bereaved families. It has also been requested from the Government of Nepal to immediately arrange for the necessary health services, treatment and support for effective treatment of the injured, wishing them a speedy, full and successful recovery.

The statement mentioned that social, religious, ethnic harmony, tolerance, reconciliation and brotherhood are the identity of Nepal, and any kind of violence, malice, hatred or division will weaken the nation and society.

NRNA has urged the government, political parties, civil society, local communities and all stakeholders to seek a peaceful resolution to the problem through dialogue, cooperation, restraint and mutual understanding to normalize the current difficult situation as soon as possible, ensure the security of citizens' lives and property, maintain social harmony, and re-establish peace, security and trust in society.

काठमांडू। अनिवासी नेपाली संघ देवनगुंज, सिराहा, सुनसरी आदि स्थानमे घटित घटना पर गहींर चिन्ता व्यक्त करैत सरकार आ समस्त सरोकारवाला स सामाजिक सौहार्द कायम राखब आ समस्याक शान्तिपूर्ण समाधान ताकब आग्रह केने अछि ।

एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष डॉ. हेमराज शर्मा द्वारा गुरुवार के जारी प्रेस विज्ञप्ति में घटना में जान गंवाबै वाला नागरिक के प्रति शोक व्यक्त करलौ गेलौ छै, आरू शोक संतप्त परिवार के प्रति सहानुभूति व्यक्त करलौ गेलौ छै । नेपाल सरकारसँ सेहो आग्रह कएल गेल अछि जे घायल लोकनिक शीघ्र, पूर्ण आ सफल स्वस्थ्य हेबाक कामना करैत तत्काल आवश्यक स्वास्थ्य सेवा, उपचार आ प्रभावी उपचारक लेल सहयोगक व्यवस्था कयल जाय ।

विज्ञप्ति मे सामाजिक, धार्मिक, जातीय सौहार्द, सहिष्णुता, मेलमिलाप आ भाईचारा नेपालक पहिचान अछि, आ कोनो तरहक हिंसा, दुर्भावना, घृणा वा विभाजन राष्ट्र आ समाज कमजोर करत से उल्लेख कएल गेल अछि ।

एनआरएनए सरकार, राजनीतिक दल, नागरिक समाज, स्थानीय समुदाय आरू सब हितधारक स॑ आग्रह करल॑ छै कि वर्तमान कठिन परिस्थिति क॑ जल्द स॑ जल्द सामान्य करै लेली, नागरिकऽ के जीवन आरू संपत्ति के सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करै लेली, सामाजिक सौहार्द कायम रखै लेली, आरू समाज म॑ शांति, सुरक्षा आरू विश्वास क॑ पुनः स्थापित करै लेली संवाद, सहयोग, संयम आरू आपसी समझदारी के माध्यम स॑ समस्या के शांतिपूर्ण समाधान खोजै के कोशिश करलऽ जाय ।

title: Nepal PM urges calm after unrest leaves 3 dead - CP24
description: Nepal PM urges calm after unrest leaves 3 dead  CP24
publisher.title: CP24
full_article:
KATHMANDU, Nepal - Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Thursday appealed for calm after clashes between Hindu and Muslim groups in the country’s south sparked unrest that has left three people dead.

Shah, who has kept a low profile since being elected in March, broke his silence to deliver his first address to the nation, calling on his countrymen to be “responsible citizens and remove the clouds of unrest.”

The violence began late Sunday in a village in the southern Sunsari district, which borders India, after an argument over loud music and the use of religious flags during a Hindu procession, according to officials.

Police opened fire to disperse the crowd, said local official Poshan Lamichhane. Two men died in the unrest, according to police spokesman Abi Narayan Kafle.

Authorities are investigating the deaths and have imposed a curfew in Sunsari and neighbouring districts to prevent further clashes.

A third man was killed Thursday in the nearby Siraha district during a demonstration that took place while the curfew was in force.

“I, on behalf of the government, sincerely appeal to the citizens, civil society, religious communities, all respected leaders, all political parties and responsible media, to exercise patience and restrain and maintain peace, harmony, brotherhood and national unity,” Shah said in a video address.

Nepal, a secular republic where more than 80 per cent of the population is Hindu, has seen tensions flare occasionally in the southern plains, where sizeable Hindu and Muslim communities live side by side.

In his address, Shah vowed that the investigation would be “completely fair and transparent.”

“The government is committed to bringing to justice whoever is responsible for the incident,” he said.

Kafle, the police official, said efforts were being made to restore order.

“We have kept all police officials in the field on alert and are trying to protect public property and prevent any conflicting situation with minimal use of force,” he told AFP.

काठमाण्डू, नेपाल : देशक दक्षिणमे हिन्दू आ मुस्लिम समूहक बीच भेल झड़पमे अशांति उत्पन्न भेलाक बाद नेपालक प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह बृहस्पतिदिन शान्तताक अपील केलनि अछि ।

मार्च म॑ चुनलऽ गेलऽ के बाद स॑ निचला स्तर प॑ रहलऽ शाह न॑ अपनऽ देश के सामने अपनऽ पहिलऽ संबोधन दै लेली अपनऽ चुप्पी तोड़ी क॑ अपनऽ देशवासी सिनी क॑ “जिम्मेदार नागरिक बन॑ आरू अशांति के बादल दूर करै” के आह्वान करलकै ।

अधिकारी सब के अनुसार भारत के सीमा स सटल दक्षिणी सुनसरी जिला के एकटा गाम में रविदिन देर राति हिन्दू जुलूस के दौरान जोरदार संगीत आ धार्मिक झंडा के प्रयोग के ल क बहस के बाद हिंसा शुरू भेल।

भीड़ के तितर-बितर करय लेल पुलिस गोली चला देलक स्थानीय अधिकारी पोशन लामिछाने जानकारी देलनि। अशांति मे दू गोटेक मृत्यु भेल पुलिस प्रवक्ता अबी नारायण काफ्लेक अनुसार।

अधिकारी सब मौत के जांच क रहल अछि आओर सुनसरी आओर पड़ोसी जिला मे आओर झड़प नहि होए ताहि लेल कर्फ्यू लगा देने अछि.

बृहस्पतिदिन नजदीकी सिराहा जिला मे कर्फ्यू लागू रहला के दौरान भेल प्रदर्शन के दौरान तेसर आदमी के मौत भ गेल।

शाह न॑ वीडियो संबोधन म॑ कहलकै कि हम्में सरकार के तरफ स॑ नागरिक, नागरिक समाज, धार्मिक समुदाय, सब सम्मानित नेता, सब राजनीतिक दल आरू जिम्मेदार मीडिया स॑ ईमानदारी स॑ अपील करै छियै कि धैर्य के प्रयोग करी क॑ शांति, सौहार्द, भाईचारा आरू राष्ट्रीय एकता क॑ संयमित करी क॑ कायम रखै ।

धर्मनिरपेक्ष गणराज्य नेपाल, जहाँ ८० प्रतिशत स॑ अधिक आबादी हिन्दू छै, दक्षिणी मैदानऽ म॑ बीच-बीच म॑ तनाव पैदा होय रहलऽ छै, जहां बड़ऽ-बड़ऽ हिन्दू आरू मुस्लिम समुदाय एक-दूसरा के साथ रह॑ छै ।

अपनऽ संबोधन म॑ शाह न॑ प्रण लेलकै कि जांच “पूरी तरह स॑ निष्पक्ष आरू पारदर्शी” होतै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, सरकार एहि घटना के लेल जे कियो जिम्मेदार अछि ओकरा कानून के सामने लाबय लेल प्रतिबद्ध अछि।

पुलिस अधिकारी काफ्ले कहलनि जे, व्यवस्था बहाल करबाक प्रयास भ रहल अछि।

ओ एएफपी स कहला जे हम मैदान मे मौजूद सबटा पुलिस अधिकारी कए सतर्क रखने छी आ सार्वजनिक संपत्ति क सुरक्षा आ कम स कम बल प्रयोग स कोनो तरह क परस्पर विरोधी स्थिति कए रोकबाक कोशिश मे छी।
